info.title: MSP API
info.description: Multi-sport competition platform. Errors are Problem Details with a stable `code` (contracts/errors.json) and the request's `correlationId`.

get.description: Active ISO 3166-1 countries, ordered by alpha-2 code. Cacheable for an hour; send the `ETag` back as `If-None-Match` to get 304.
Active ISO 4217 currencies (money only), ordered by code, with their minor units. Cacheable for an hour; send the `ETag` back as `If-None-Match` to get 304.
Active ISO 639-1 languages, ordered by code. Cacheable for an hour; send the `ETag` back as `If-None-Match` to get 304.

Active IANA time zones, ordered by ID. `country` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper case) keeps only that country's zones; a country without zones gives an empty list. Cacheable for an hour; send the `ETag` back as `If-None-Match` to get 304.

The tenant whose site this host serves: slug, display name and primary domain. The tenant comes from the request host (`X-Forwarded-Host` from a trusted proxy). Responses differ per host. Cacheable for a minute; send the `ETag` back as `If-None-Match` to get 304.
The settings of the tenant named by `X-Tenant-Id`, with their `version` (also the `ETag`).

patch.description: Changes the keys sent of the settings of the tenant named by `X-Tenant-Id`; missing or null keys stay as they are. Any other key, or a value of the wrong type, is 400 VALIDATION_INVALID_REQUEST with an `errors` entry naming it. Send `version` from the last read to get 409 TENANT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT instead of overwriting someone else's change; `If-Match` with the `ETag` works the same way (if both are sent, both must match).

get.description: The status and access mode of the tenant named by `X-Tenant-Id`, with the reason and time of the change that put it in that status. Available while the tenant is suspended or archived, so its owner sees why every other request is `403 TENANT_BLOCKED`.

The members of the tenant named by `X-Tenant-Id`, oldest first, with their email and active roles. Filter by `status` (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED or REMOVED); without it, removed members are left out. `limit` is 1–100 (25). Every page read is audited.
A member of the tenant named by `X-Tenant-Id`, with their active roles and `version` (also the `ETag`).

post.description: ACTIVE → SUSPENDED, with a reason: the member loses access to the tenant and keeps their roles. Only an owner changes an owner, and the last active owner can't be suspended or removed. The body `{ "reason": … }` is required. The reason is kept permanently on the membership and in the audit trail: don't include personal data. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 AUTH_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the member changed since.
SUSPENDED → ACTIVE, with the roles the member held. The body is optional. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 AUTH_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the member changed since.

ACTIVE or SUSPENDED → REMOVED, with a reason. Final: rejoining needs a new invitation. Only an owner changes an owner, and the last active owner can't be suspended or removed. The body `{ "reason": … }` is required. The reason is kept permanently on the membership and in the audit trail: don't include personal data. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 AUTH_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the member changed since.

Assigns a tenant role (`roleCode`, e.g. REGISTRAR) to an active or suspended member, tenant-wide: `scopeType` is TENANT (the default) until competitions, teams and contests exist. Only an owner grants TENANT_OWNER. Returns the member. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 AUTH_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the member changed since.

Revokes an active role assignment of the member; it is kept as history. Only an owner revokes TENANT_OWNER, and the last active owner keeps it. The body is optional. Returns the member. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 AUTH_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the member changed since.

post.summary: Invite a person to the tenant
post.description: Invites `email` to join the tenant named by `X-Tenant-Id` with `roleCodes` (tenant roles, tenant-wide). Only an owner invites with TENANT_OWNER or replaces a pending invitation that has it. A person who is already a member (active or suspended) can't be invited. The invitation lasts 7 days; the email with its link goes out shortly after (one link at a time: a resent email's link replaces the earlier one). A pending invitation to the same email is revoked and replaced.

get.description: The invitations of the tenant named by `X-Tenant-Id`, oldest first, with their email, roles and status. Filter by `status` (PENDING, EXPIRED, ACCEPTED or REVOKED); without it, the ones still pending, expired ones included. `limit` is 1–100 (25). Every page read is audited.
An invitation of the tenant named by `X-Tenant-Id`, with its email, roles, status and `version` (also the `ETag`).

post.description: PENDING → REVOKED: the invitation's link stops working. An accepted, revoked or expired invitation can't be revoked; only an owner revokes one with TENANT_OWNER. Sending its email changes its version, so a revoke may get 409 once while the email goes out. The body is optional. Returns the invitation. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 AUTH_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the invitation changed since.

get.description: Outbox messages of every module, newest first, without their payloads. Filter by `module` (a module schema) and `status` (PENDING, PROCESSED or FAILED); `limit` is 1–100 (25). `heldBackBy` names the earlier message a PENDING one waits for.

post.description: Moves one FAILED message back to PENDING with its attempts reset; the processor delivers it on its next poll. Fix the cause first: a message that fails again ends FAILED again. The reason is kept permanently in the audit trail: don't include personal data.

get.description: Audit entries of every tenant, newest first. Filter by `tenantId`, `actorId`, `action` (an action code), `entityType` and `entityId` (`entityId` needs `entityType`), `correlationId`, `outcome` (SUCCESS, FAILURE or DENIED), and `from` (inclusive) / `to` (exclusive), ISO 8601 instants with an offset (encode `+` as `%2B`); `limit` is 1–100 (25). Entries recorded through a module's outbox arrive shortly after the action, so one can appear before a page already read. Every page read is itself audited: don't poll this list.

post.description: Invites `email` to join the tenant as TENANT_OWNER, usually while it is PROVISIONING; an ARCHIVED tenant is refused. A person who is already a member can't be invited. The invitation lasts 7 days; the email with its link goes out shortly after (one link at a time: a resent email's link replaces the earlier one). A pending invitation to the same email is revoked and replaced.

get.description: Every tenant, ordered by slug. Filter by `status` (PROVISIONING, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED or ARCHIVED); `limit` is 1–100 (25). Every page read is audited.

post.description: Creates a tenant in PROVISIONING. `slug` (3–40 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, not a reserved word) names its platform subdomain, never changes and is never reused, even after the tenant is archived. Country, time zone, locale (`en` or `en-UG`) and currency must be active reference data. `publicEnabled` defaults to false; the public site shows only while the tenant is ACTIVE.

get.description: One tenant with its profile, status, main settings and `version` (also the `ETag`). The version is the tenant row's only: a settings change doesn't change it.

patch.description: Changes the fields sent; missing or null fields stay as they are. The slug never changes, and the status changes only through the status actions. Send `version` from the last read to get 409 TENANT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT instead of overwriting someone else's change; `If-Match` with the `ETag` works the same way (if both are sent, both must match). The version is the tenant row's only: a settings change made since your read (here or through the admin settings endpoint) is not detected.

post.description: PROVISIONING → ACTIVE: setup is done; the public site shows if `publicEnabled`. The body is optional. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 TENANT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the tenant changed since.

ACTIVE → SUSPENDED, with a reason: the tenant is blocked until restored. The body `{ "reason": … }` is required (no body: VALIDATION_MALFORMED_REQUEST). The reason is kept permanently in the status history and the audit trail: don't include personal data. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 TENANT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the tenant changed since.
SUSPENDED → ACTIVE. The body is optional. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 TENANT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the tenant changed since.

ACTIVE or SUSPENDED → ARCHIVED, with a reason. Its data and slug are kept; the slug is never reused. The body `{ "reason": … }` is required (no body: VALIDATION_MALFORMED_REQUEST). The reason is kept permanently in the status history and the audit trail: don't include personal data. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 TENANT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the tenant changed since.

ARCHIVED → SUSPENDED, with a reason; restore it as a separate step. The body `{ "reason": … }` is required (no body: VALIDATION_MALFORMED_REQUEST). The reason is kept permanently in the status history and the audit trail: don't include personal data. Send `version` or `If-Match` from the last read to get 409 TENANT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT if the tenant changed since.

Signs in with email and password and starts a session: the response sets the session cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict; 12 hours sliding, 7 days at most). An unknown email, a wrong password, a locked or unconfirmed account all answer `AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`. Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes. Limited to 20 attempts a minute per client address and 10 per 15 minutes per email (`AUTH_RATE_LIMITED`, with `Retry-After`). Needs `X-CSRF: 1` like every other change.
Ends this session and deletes the session cookie.

get.description: The signed-in user: ID, email, active platform roles, and the tenants they are an active member of with their roles there (empty until memberships exist).

post.summary: Ask for a password reset email
post.description: Sends a password reset link to the email if it belongs to an account. Always answers 202, whether or not it does. The link works once, for 1 hour, and only the newest link works. Limited to 10 requests an hour per client address and 3 an hour per email (`AUTH_RATE_LIMITED`, with `Retry-After`). Needs `X-CSRF: 1`.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token
post.description: Sets a new password with the token from a reset email's link. The token works once, for 1 hour, and only the newest one works; otherwise `AUTH_RESET_TOKEN_INVALID`. The new password needs at least 12 characters (`AUTH_PASSWORD_REJECTED`, the rule in `detail`). Signs out every session of the user and clears a lockout; it does not sign in. Needs `X-CSRF: 1`.

Changes the signed-in user's password. A wrong current password answers `AUTH_CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID` and counts toward the lockout (five lock the account for 15 minutes). The new password needs at least 12 characters (`AUTH_PASSWORD_REJECTED`, the rule in `detail`). The user's other sessions end within 5 minutes; this one stays (the response renews its cookie). Needs `X-CSRF: 1`.

AssignmentScope.description: A role assignment scope that can grant a tenant action.

AssignRoleRequest.description:
A role to give a member: its code and scope (`TENANT` when not sent; the only scope S03 accepts, so
`scopeId` stays empty). `version`, when sent, must be the membership's current one.

AuditEntryResponse.description:
One audit entry as platform staff see it: every column, with `metadata` as the JSON object it was stored as
(personal data already masked when it was recorded).

ChangeMemberStatusRequest.description: The optional body of `restore`: `version`, when sent, must be the membership's current one.

ChangeMemberStatusWithReasonRequest.description:
The body of `suspend` and `remove` (audit `REQUIRED_WITH_REASON`). The reason is kept permanently on
the membership and in the audit trail and is not redacted: it must not contain personal data.

ChangeTenantStatusRequest.description: The optional body of `activate` and `restore`: `version`, when sent, must be the tenant's current one.

ChangeTenantStatusWithReasonRequest.description:
The body of `suspend`, `archive` and `unarchive` (audit `REQUIRED_WITH_REASON`). The reason is kept
permanently in the status history and the audit trail and is not redacted: it must not contain personal data.

CountryResponse.description: An ISO 3166-1 country: alpha-2 `code` (`UG`), alpha-3, numeric code and English name.

CreateTenantRequest.description:
A new tenant. Every field but `publicEnabled` (default false) is required; unknown members are rejected,
so a status can't be sent (a new tenant is always `PROVISIONING`).

CurrencyResponse.description: An ISO 4217 currency: alphabetic `code` (`UGX`), numeric code, English name, minor units (UGX 0).

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Ask for a password reset email.

InvitationResponse.description:
An invitation as the admin API shows it. `status` is `EXPIRED` for a pending one past `expiresAt`. The
email is shown to every holder of `membership.read`, like a member's (owner, S03-T4b), and never logged or
audited. `version` (also the `ETag`) changes whenever the invitation does, a resent email included.

InvitationState.description:
An invitation as people see it: the stored status, with InvitationState.Expired derived from a pending invitation's
`expires_at` (S03 D12). Never stored.

InviteMemberRequest.description: Invite a person to the tenant: their email and the tenant roles they get, tenant-wide.

LanguageResponse.description: An ISO 639-1 language: two-letter `code` (`sw`) and English name.

LoginRequest.description: Sign in with email and password.

MemberResponse.description:
A member of the tenant as the admin API shows them, with their active roles. The email is the user's only
identifier until people have profiles; shown to every holder of `membership.read` (owner, S03-T4b) and never
logged or audited. `version` (also the `ETag`) is the membership's; role changes change it too.

MemberRoleResponse.description: An active role assignment: the role, where it applies (`scopeId` null tenant-wide) and when it was granted.

MeResponse.description: The signed-in user: their own email, platform roles and the tenants they are an active member of.

MeTenantResponse.description: A tenant the user is an active member of, with the codes of the roles they hold there (any scope).

MinorRegistrationConsent.description:
Whether a guardian's consent is needed before a minor is registered for a competition (Q11). Consent before public
exposure is always required, whatever this says.

OutboxMessageResponse.description:
One outbox message in the platform diagnostics: envelope and delivery state, no payload. `heldBackBy` is set on
a `PENDING` message that waits for an earlier, not yet processed message of its aggregate.

OutboxMessageStatus.description: Delivery status of an outbox message (docs/domain/state-machines.md, "Outbox message").

PageInfo.description:
The `page` member of a cursor-paginated list (docs/architecture/api-conventions.md): pass
NextCursor as `cursor` to get the next page; it is null on the last page.

code.description: Stable error code, `<AREA>_<CONDITION>` (contracts/errors.json). Clients branch on it.

correlationId.description: The request's correlation ID (also the `X-Correlation-Id` response header).

errors.description: Validation failures, one per field: `field` (camelCase) and `code`.

RedriveOutboxMessageRequest.description:
Why the message is re-driven; the audit entry records it (action audit `REQUIRED_WITH_REASON`). Kept permanently
and not redacted, so it must not contain personal data.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Set a new password with the token from a reset email's link.

RevokeInvitationRequest.description: The optional body of `revoke`: `version`, when sent, must be the invitation's current one.

RevokeRoleRequest.description: The optional body of `revoke`: `version`, when sent, must be the membership's current one.

SiteResponse.description:
The public site's identity: `PUBLIC` fields only. PrimaryDomain is the host the site
prefers, which may differ from the host the request came in on.

TenantAccessMode.description: What a tenant may do, derived from its status (and, from S04, its subscription): state-machines.md.

TenantAccessResponse.description:
A tenant's access as its owner sees it: `status`, the `accessMode` derived from it, and the
`reason` (null when the change needs none, such as an activation) and time (`since`) of the change that put the
tenant in its status.

TenantListItem.description:
A tenant in the platform list. No settings: the list runs under no tenant, and settings are tenant-owned (read one
tenant for them). `version` is the tenant row's, as in the detail.

TenantResponse.description:
A tenant as the platform API shows it: the tenant and its main settings. Read under the tenant (the settings are
tenant-owned). `version` (also the `ETag`), `createdAt` and `updatedAt` are the tenant row's
only: a settings change doesn't change them, so the same `ETag` can come with different settings. Send
`version` back with a change to make it fail with `409 TENANT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT` if someone else changed
the tenant first. The settings have their own version at `/api/admin/v1/tenant/settings`.

TenantSettingsResponse.description:
A tenant's settings as the admin API shows them. `version` (also the `ETag`) and `updatedAt` are the
settings row's, not the tenant's: send `version` back with a change to make it fail with
`409 TENANT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT` if someone else changed the settings first.

TimeZoneResponse.description: An IANA time zone: its ID as `code` (`Africa/Kampala`) and its country; no country for `Etc/UTC`.

UpdateTenantProfileRequest.description:
The profile fields to change; a missing or null field stays as it is. The slug and the status can't be changed here
(unknown members are rejected). `version`, when sent, must be the tenant's current version.

UpdateTenantSettingsRequest.description:
The settings to change; a missing or null key stays as it is. Only these keys exist: any other key, or a value of
the wrong type, is named in `errors`. `version`, when sent, must be the settings' current version.
